crm_notes: TL;DR: Self-serve SMB DTC brand. Signed up to test hosted embeddings for product search. Got first key, low follow-through — stalled at Shopify integration step.
Customer quote (02-12 call): "If we can't get search quality up quickly, marketing won't sign off — we need a drop-in experience."

Primary pain: site search relevance and speed. Wants ~100ms median embedding lookup for UI interactions, 95th pct < 300ms. Throughput: ~200 qps at peak for search retrieval (but optimistic; current traffic smaller).
Cost sensitivity: monthly spend target <$2k while scaling testing. Concerned about per-embedding costs vs caching options. Asked for recommendation: smaller model + quantized embeddings?
Security: requires SSO for internal admin and audit logs for access. SOC2 mention during call; they have an internal checklist. No strict data residency requirement — US cloud ok.
Competitive pressure: evaluating ShopifyAI_plugin (demo in next week), trying to avoid dev time if plugin is sufficient.
